heading: CMS integrations
summary: Verified domains, API keys, and future automation are managed from Workspace Admin so the rest of the platform can reuse them. This page summarizes what is configured for your workspace and links you to the right Workspace Admin tab to make changes.
statusUnavailableDescription: Status counts are temporarily unavailable. Workspace Admin links remain available.
loadingDescription: Checking verified domains and workspace API keys.
futureAutomationDescription: Webhook lifecycle management will live in Workspace Admin. CMS will consume workspace-level webhook status once the platform service is ready.

domains.title: Verified domains
domains.description: Verify domains in Workspace Admin once, then reuse them across CMS publishing, delivery, and any future workspace product.

apiKeys.title: Workspace API keys
apiKeys.description: API keys are issued and scoped from Workspace Admin. Raw key values are shown once at creation and stored only as hashes -- they cannot be revealed again.

contentApi.title: Content API
contentApi.description: Issue a read-only API key for headless content delivery. The key only grants access to published content and cannot mutate entries.
contentApi.linkLabel: Create a read-only Content API key

publisher.title: Publisher automation
publisher.description: Issue a publisher API key for build pipelines or scheduled publishing tools that need to author and publish entries on your behalf.
